points: Flock Safety's autonomous vehicle technology records video upon police activation.
The company is facing public backlash and calls for regulation.

articles.title: Two years after launch, Walmart’s Flipkart is closing in on India’s quick-commerce leaders
articles.description: Flipkart's quick-commerce venture is delivering 1.1 million to 1.2 million orders a day, nearly triple its November volume.
articles.summary: Two years after its launch, Walmart's Flipkart has significantly increased its order volume, nearly tripling its daily operations compared to when it first started. The news underscores Flipkart's rapid growth and its position as a major player in India's quick-commerce market.
points: Walmart's Flipkart has nearly tripled its daily order volume since November, delivering between 1.1 and 1.2 million orders per day.
This significant growth highlights Flipkart's success and its impact on India's quick-commerce industry.
Despite the growth, the article does not specify whether Flipkart has overtaken other quick-commerce leaders in India.
articles.insight: Flipkart's substantial growth within the first two years of its launch is a testament to its potential in reshaping the quick-commerce landscape in India. However, its position relative to other established quick-commerce competitors remains unclear based on this article.
